test_title: PYST 28: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 25th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven friends are sitting on a circular table facing the centre. A sits second to the left of B. C sits between B and G. D sits second to the left of C. E who sits second to the right of G sits between A and F. Who sits second to the left of G?
solution: Seven friends are sitting on a circular table facing the centre. 1) A sits second to the left of B. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5de9c201d3572650ec7a4cdea017968a88d5dbb4ac3b51b8fc26e919b1b92087.png] 2) C sits between B and G.
